measure: research/pptx_thin_boxes.py measure: per probe, the top of the 'A' and the bottom of the 'X' of the one line, in points from the top of the box
licence: Synthetic fixture under the project's MIT licence. The PDFs are not stored: they embed font subsets.

libreoffice.method: soffice --headless --convert-to pdf with a fresh user profile; Calibri drawn as Carlito

powerpoint.renderer: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac 16.114.1, macOS 27.0.1, Apple Silicon
powerpoint.method: A copy of the fixture, byte-identical to it before and after, opened with open -a; AppleScript 'save active presentation ... as save as PDF'. PowerPoint asked for access to the output folder, which the maintainer granted; it then wrote the PDF. Nothing was edited. Calibri from the PowerPoint bundle.
powerpoint.placement: With insets at least as tall as the box, PowerPoint moves each inset by half their excess, so the text area is a line (top - bottom + height) / 2 from the top: 0pt in the 0pt box, 2.0pt in the 4pt box, 3.6pt in the 7.2pt box; the text hangs below it under t, centres on it under ctr and stands on it under b.
